title: a canvas keeps its photograph when the page rewrites its style attribute

geometry.reason: with scripting off the mirror renders a canvas as its fallback content, stretched to the column width

exclude.pixels: the canvas is most of the page and its photograph is scaled by P-123's stretch

notes: P-117 claimed the photograph is lost forever to a style write; this page disproved it — restyled() re-hangs the shot from the held blob, and the resources dimension passing is the pin that keeps it that way
